title: App shell: page gutter, sidebar (real user, super-admin gating, single active item), top bar (theme, search, titles), Escape loop, notification click
goal: Every archetype page has a consistent gutter and max width, the sidebar shows the real user and exactly one active item, the top bar has working theme/search/titles, Escape no longer recurses, and clicking a notification navigates.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Verified: app-shell.tsx:38 <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-auto"> has no padding and ListPage (list-page.tsx:176), DetailPage (detail-page.tsx:101) and EntityForm (entity-form.tsx:119) roots are bare -> 101/187 routes have h1 at x=0 and the sidebar collapse toggle (absolute -right-3) covers subtitles. Non-archetype pages already pad themselves (W6 batches migrate them to PageContainer). Electron: app-shell.tsx:21-23 draws a fixed full-width h-8 drag strip over the sidebar logo. sidebar.tsx: NavItemLink active = `pathname === href || startsWith(href + '/')` (line ~240) -> parent+child both active on 49 routes; footer hard-codes "AS / Arjun S / arjun@travelcrm.io" (358-362); Super Admin shown when `user.role === 'admin'` (299) although super admins are a MASTER_DB registry (backend middleware/require-super-admin.ts) -> tenant admins see a link to a 403 page; logo tile uses undefined `from-primary-400 via-primary-500 to-primary-600` -> blank white tile in light mode; fixed bottom block (Help, Settings, ConnectionStatus green dot, user card) leaves ~10 nav items visible at 1366x768. top-navbar.tsx: theme toggle keeps its own state and toggles the .dark class (328-334) bypassing next-themes (ThemeProvider is in src/app/layout.tsx) -> not persisted; Search button dispatches a keydown on `document` (348) but CommandPalette listens on `window` (command-palette.tsx:85); getPageTitle() (line 29) returns "" for 23 routes (credit/debit notes, travellers, reports/{customer,team,visa}, super-admin/*, help, import, onboarding); handleNotificationClick (191-207) only navigates when n.actionUrl exists - the backend notifications table has reference_type/reference_id (tenant-schema.ts:866-880), so clicks do nothing (FR-9). keyboard-shortcuts-provider.tsx:62-77 Escape handler re-dispatches an Escape keydown on document which the same listener handles again -> "Maximum call stack size exceeded" (6 page errors per keypress). dashboard/page.tsx:774 and components/domain/ai-daily-briefing.tsx:24 greet "Arjun". Orphans: /fleet/rate-cards not in nav; /campaigns*, /reports/{customer,team,visa}, /onboarding highlight nothing. Super-admin detection uses a NEW backend endpoint added by B12 (W3): GET /api/v1/admin/whoami -> 200 {success:true,data:{isSuperAdmin:boolean}} for any authenticated user; until it exists the call 404s and the link must stay hidden silently.
steps: Create src/components/layout/page-container.tsx: `PageContainer({ children, className, width = 'default' })` rendering `<div data-slot="page-container" className={cn('mx-auto flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-ds-4 px-ds-6 py-ds-5', width === 'default' && 'max-w-screen-2xl', width === 'narrow' && 'max-w-5xl', className)}>`; export from components/layout/index.ts.

Wrap the archetype roots (ONLY the root element, no other logic): ListPage root -> PageContainer (keep its existing classes on an inner element or pass className); DetailPage root -> PageContainer; EntityForm: PageContainer width="narrow" around the <form>.

app-shell.tsx: remove the fixed Electron drag strip; make the top navbar header the drag region (`electron-drag` on the header, `electron-no-drag` on its interactive children) and only pad the sidebar logo row if the Electron window uses an overlay title bar (check desktop/electron/main config; do not edit electron/ unless required and then only the title bar option). Add id="main-content" tabIndex={-1} to <main>.

Move the nav definition (groups, bottomNav, superAdminNav) into src/components/layout/nav-config.ts and export `findActiveHref(pathname)`: longest-prefix match over ALL hrefs (exact or startsWith(href + '/')) plus an alias map for routes without their own item (e.g. '/campaigns' -> the campaigns/marketing item that exists in the config, '/reports/<x>' -> '/reports', '/onboarding' -> '/dashboard'). NavItemLink uses activeHref === item.href. Add a nav item for /fleet/rate-cards in the fleet group.

Sidebar footer: real user from useAuthStore (name, email, initials via getInitials from @/lib/utils -> "Demo Admin" -> "DA"); clicking opens a DropdownMenu (Profile -> /settings/profile, Help -> /help, Settings -> /settings, Super Admin (only if super admin), Sign out using the same logout flow as the top-bar user menu). Fold Help/Settings/ConnectionStatus into this compact footer so at 1366x768 at least 14 nav items are visible; ConnectionStatus dot gets aria-label + Tooltip text ("Live updates connected"/"Reconnecting...").

Create src/hooks/use-is-super-admin.ts: GET /admin/whoami via the api client once per session (module cache + sessionStorage), returns {isSuperAdmin:false} on ANY error (404/401/403/network) without toast or console.error. Sidebar shows the Super Admin entry only when true. Delete the role==='admin' heuristic.

Logo tile: `bg-ds-primary text-ds-primary-foreground rounded-ds-md`. Replace px/palette classes in sidebar.tsx (w-[240px] -> w-60, collapsed w-16 or w-(--sidebar-collapsed), text-[13px] -> text-sm, text-[11px] -> text-xs). Collapse toggle gets aria-label + aria-expanded.
top-navbar.tsx theme: `const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme()` from next-themes, render the icon only after mount; aria-label "Switch to dark theme"/"Switch to light theme".

Search: command-palette.tsx listens for `window` event 'travelcrm:open-command-palette' (in addition to Ctrl/Cmd+K) and opens; the top-bar button dispatches `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('travelcrm:open-command-palette'))`.

getPageTitle(pathname): derive from nav-config (findActiveHref + item title) and an explicit map for subpages/new/edit/detail (e.g. "New invoice", "Edit lead", "Credit notes", "Debit notes", "Travellers", "Customer report", "Team report", "Visa report", "Super Admin - Tenants", "Help Center", "Import", "Onboarding"); never return an empty string (fallback: title-case of the last static segment).

FR-9: handleNotificationClick navigates to `n.actionUrl ?? routeForReference(type, id)` where type/id are read from referenceType/reference_type and referenceId/reference_id (the API may return either casing until B11 normalises it): lead -> /leads/:id, contact -> /contacts/:id, invoice -> /invoices/:id, payment -> /payments/:id, task -> /tasks/:id, itinerary -> /itineraries/:id, trip -> /fleet/trips/:id, follow_up -> /follow-ups; anything else -> /notifications. Put routeForReference in src/lib/notifications/route.ts (new) so the notifications page can reuse it. The bell button gets aria-label "Notifications"; the user menu shows the real user name.

keyboard-shortcuts-provider.tsx: delete the synthetic Escape re-dispatch (Radix dialogs/sheets handle Escape themselves). If use-keyboard-shortcuts.ts (line ~43) needs a guard, ignore events with `isTrusted === false`. Add a unit test that one Escape keydown calls the handler at most once and does not throw.

BUG-020: dashboard/page.tsx greeting (~774) and ai-daily-briefing.tsx (~24) use the auth user first name (fallback "there"). Edit only those lines in those two files. `grep -rn "Arjun\|arjun@" src --include=*.tsx` (excluding tests) -> 0.
BUG-021: super-admin/layout.tsx - make sure the top-bar title is set (via getPageTitle map) and the no-access panel (data-testid super-admin-no-access) uses ds tokens.

Do NOT edit any e2e spec in this batch (B09 codemods all spec imports in parallel). The expected spec breakages (auth-shell.spec.ts:154 user name, super-admin.spec.ts:55 link now hidden for tenant admins) are fixed by B17 - list them in your report.
filesAllowlist: desktop/electron/main.ts (title bar option only, if required)
acceptance: Probe: on all listed routes at 1366 and 1920, h1 left gutter >= 16px from <main>, no horizontal overflow, exactly one `aside [aria-current=page]`, non-empty `header h2`.
Sidebar footer shows "Demo Admin" / admin@demo.com for the e2e admin (FR-3: shows whoever is logged in).
Super Admin link hidden for admin@demo.com; navigating to /super-admin directly still shows the no-access panel.
Theme toggle persists across reload (localStorage theme updated).
Clicking the top-bar "Search..." opens the command palette.
Pressing Escape produces no page errors.
Clicking a notification with referenceType lead navigates to /leads/<id> (FR-9).
lint-gate --zero passes for the shell files.

allowedSpecFailures: super-admin.spec.ts:55 (link now hidden for tenant admins - B17)

notes: Runs in parallel with B06 (disjoint files). The archetype files are touched again by B14/B16 - keep your edit to the root wrapper so their diffs stay small.
